 COMMON ORDER WP.No.19213 of 2017 has been filed by a company that is engaged as the stockist for various brands of tea.

The petitioner seeks a writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for and quashing a report of the 4 th respondent/referal lab, dated 13.06.2017, that has proceeded on the basis that the tea stocked is 'sub-standard' as defined under Section 3(1)(zx) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 (in short 'Act') and does not conform to the standards laid down therein and under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives)
Regulations, 2011, on the ground that water soluble ash falls below the minimum standard limit.
